blocks.text: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) has yet to confirm reports of a Chinese naval and air exercise in Bajo de Masinloc, saying it had monitored only one China Coast Guard (CCG) vessel and one Chinese maritime militia vessel during a patrol in the area a day before.
